comment: Sameness-court gold pins (2026-08-30). Every WRONG verdict from plans/judge-ledger-audit.md is pinned on its correct side, plus both-sides pins for each doctrine boundary (home-restaurant rule, modifier classes, reject vs new, diacritics, subtype-never-folds). Context fields mirror the D2 wire: mention/threadPlace/termHomePlaces on the case, homePlaces/samePlace on candidates. Real corpus quotes throughout.

cases.why: audit WRONG match: subtype folded into category; a Shanghai lumpia is a distinct order
cases.mention: I had the Shanghai lumpia, sisig, and kare kare and left satisfied.

cases.why: audit WRONG match: regional style folded into generic bbq
audit WRONG match: dietary words are specifications a diner relies on
audit UNDECIDABLE ruled to keep: aioli≠mayo without source evidence equating them
audit wrong-split-lean gone the KEEP way: regional style is its own order
junk-minting class: bare quantity, no food noun (judge's own reason called it garbage)
cases.mention: 5 piece with some tater tots. And sauces. Lots of sauces.

cases.why: junk-minting class: thread-local branch reference, not a business name
cases.mention: The parking lot at the south lamar location is pretty insane at lunchtime, be warned.

cases.why: junk-minting class: material/vessel is not an orderable thing
junk-minting class: generic adjective minted as an item
junk-minting class: a pro-form that only worked inside its thread
cases.mention: In addition to all of the above - Jacobys makes a nice mushroom based one.

cases.why: reject boundary other side: an unfamiliar but real orderable dish is new, never reject
venue-name decoration at the same restaurant is the venue, not the dish (OTOKO rule)
cases.mention: We got the Soto Omakase for my birthday and it was quite good, but the price they charged was not worth what we got.

cases.why: narration decoration (course count + 'experience') at the same restaurant is one offering
cases.mention: Come check out Sushi Endo, it's a wonderful 20 course omakase experience located in West campus.

cases.why: channel modifier (take home) names how the same kitchen's offering reaches you
genuine variant even at one restaurant: the venue itself distinguishes them (Uchi has both)
the mention itself contrasts two offerings at one venue — never merge what the source distinguishes
cases.mention: Otoko does a true Tokyo style sushi omakase on Wednesday nights. The other nights are a Kyoto style kaiseki omakase which is also great.

cases.why: without same-place evidence the decorated variant stays separate (doubt says new)
audit UNDECIDABLE decided by the mention: the sentence IS the menu mapping
cases.mention: No. 16 Noodles with meat and bean sauce is the bees knees for $11.

candidates.name: noodle with meat and bean sauce

cases.why: regression pin: accentless spelling of an accented name (lane's measured strength)
regression pin: both accented, marks disagree = two words
regression pin: same brand tokens, abbreviated
regression pin: different brand tokens, same category
regression pin: established cross-language name
regression pin: component vs whole
regression pin: preparations a diner orders on purpose, even same restaurant

acceptance pin 2026-08-30: the dedupe judge merged these as a 'spelling variant' — wrong: bourbon is whisky and is not scotch; scotch is a regional subtype, whisky the category. Subtype vs category = two claims.
acceptance pin 2026-08-30: the judge merged 'barbecue sauce' into 'bbq' while itself ruling 'bbq sauce' vs 'bbq' = new — transitivity-inconsistent. A sauce is not the flavor/tradition category.
